final: WITH counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), shares AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, 1.0 * qc_count / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM shares ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST, arcref LIMIT 10
